title: New position
prompt: The robot is at position x, driving at speed. Return where it is after one frame of delta seconds. From 0 at 100 pixels per second, a 0.1 s frame puts it at 10.
starter:
func new_position(x, speed, delta) -> float:
	return x
hints: Old position plus the distance moved this frame.
solution:
func new_position(x, speed, delta) -> float:
	return x + speed * delta
